name: Goi xoai kho ca loc
summary: Sour green mango tossed with lightly salty, chewy dried snakehead and a garlic-chili fish sauce.
origin: Đồng Tháp Mười, in the old Long An half of Tây Ninh. Dried snakehead from kênh 79 is the base of the plate.
taste: Sour mango, chewy salted fish, and garlic-chili fish sauce.
howToEat: Order it with the other dried-snakehead plates, or with rice.
where: The drying yards along kênh 79 and the markets that sell khô cá lóc, plus orchard and countryside tourism stops.
seoTitle: Goi xoai kho ca loc in Tay Ninh
seoDescription: Green mango with dried snakehead and garlic-chili fish sauce.
